I calimed my PF and they deposited in my account . first cheque was of amount 180000/- and second was aroung 28000/-. Usually PF companey gives the interest of 8.5% and I want this interest money to be removed from my actual money. How do I do it ? I dont know how much is mine and companeys money and how much is interest given by Provident fund office. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 9432 Country: India Title: As salam alaikum, is playing a chess haram or halal? in what condition it is haram or halal? as per quran & hadith. thanking you. Question: As salam alaikum, is playing a chess haram or halal? in what condition it is haram or halal? as per quran & hadith. thanking you. Answer ID: 9432 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2194/2015=D/1429) It is haram in every condition, it is major sin: قال في الشامي: وکرہ تحریما اللعب بالنرد وکذا الشطرنج (5:279 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
